title: Multi-horizon model supply prognosticator and enterprise adoption playbook
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Build a repeatable, cross-regional playbook and lightweight forecasting toolkit that helps product and GTM teams evaluate short- and medium-term model supply risk, enterprise adoption thresholds, and the economic cost of switching or fallback. Outputs should feed the procurement triggers and the model fallback inventory. Focus vertical: regulated enterprise buyers (finserv, health tech).
acceptance_criteria: A1: Time-series heatmap showing probability of model availability degradation per region over next 6, 12, 24 months
A2: Scoring rubric that converts signals (latency, license changes, quantization availability, hardware affinity, release cadence) into a 0-100 supply-risk score
A3: Enterprise switch-cost estimator spreadsheet with knobs for token volume, embedding usage, latency tolerance, and compliance delta
A4: Playbook document with decision ladder for procurement and recommended fallbacks mapped to Redwood products (hosted/dedicated/private)
A5: Dashboard prototype in Metabase showing top-10 signals and their weighting, with exportable CSV
deliverables: Signal-to-score mapping and scoring algorithm (notebook + README)
milestones: M3: Internal review and stakeholder sign-off (2025-03-18)
